Commentary.Commentary: The Black Caps will be surely pumped up after this and their main aim will be to play out till the end of play today with minimal damage. They could've been batted out of the game but did not let that happen. It's now up to them, how they fare in their second innings.

New Zealand will be really happy with the last hour or so. The Pakistan innings has folded for 348 from 286/3. 7 wickets for 62 runs. Once again, the spinners of the visitors and some poor decisions by the Pakistan batsmen have caused this sudden slide. Somerville was the wrecker-in-chief, as he got 4 wickets on debut. As for the hosts, Azhar Ali and Asad Shafiq made a 201-run stand, both reached their centuries, but fell soon after that. Pakistan ended with a lead of 74 but they could have surely got more than that.

OUT! That is it! William Somerville finishes with a four-fer. A soft dismissal this. It is bowled quicker and fuller on middle, Sarfraz tries to chip it into the gap but is not successful in doing so. He manages to find Jeet Raval at short mid-wicket who takes an easy catch. PAKISTAN ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 348!
Fires it on the pads, it is worked towards square leg.
Down the leg side, Sarfraz lets it be.
Fires this on the stumps now, it is blocked out.
Tosses it above the eye line. Tempting Sarfraz to go for a big hit. Ahmed resists and defends it out.
Gives it air on off, the batsman keeps it out.
Looped up by Ajaz, Afridi does well to keep it away from the danger.
Tossed up by Ajaz, the debutant does well to keep it out.
Tossed up once again, Ahmed finds the edge and this time he takes the single.
Loopy delivery by Patel, the ball finds the inside edge of Sarfraz and hits this pads.
Tossed up on off, The skipper defends it off his front foot.

Tossed up by Ajaz, Sarfraz tries to defend off his font foot. The ball finds the edge and goes towards the third man region there was an easy single there but Sarfraz refuses to give the strike to the debutant on the other end.
Shaheen Afridi is the last batsman in.

OUT! TIMBER! No. 9 is down now! Second wicket in the over for New Zealand. This is bowled flatter on off. Hasan Ali plays for the non-extant turn. The ball goes past his outside edge and hits the off pole. Ali bags a duck and William gets his third.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
This is eased through mid off for a run.
On off again, blocked.
This is flatter around off, it is kept out.
Hasan Ali is the new man in.

OUT! Suicidal from Pakistan. There was never a second run in that! Sarfraz sits down disappointed with that call. The ball is taken on the full and played to deep mid-wicket. Yasir is slow on his first run and even slips a little while turning. Sarfraz calls him back for the second and the tailender couldn't say no. He is well short of the crease as de Grandhomme fires in a quick, flat throw at the non-striker's end. Even a desperate dive couldn't save him here. Pakistan are throwing away their position of absolute superiority in this first innings.
Outside off, left alone by Yasir.
Yasir is well ahead to defend this fuller one but gets an thin inside edge onto the pads.
Flatter ball outside off, Sarfraz gets to the other end by punching the ball to sweeper cover for a run.
So close! The skipper goes to repeat the shot that he played off the first ball. This time though, he gets a thick under edge that rolls to the left of slip. He could've easily played on.
Looped up on off, driven straight to short cover.
Shorter ball outside off, Sarfraz plays it very late, almost off the stumps and finds the gap to the left of point. The batsmen come back for two.
Tossed up once again outside off, the ball turns in after pitching and finds the inside half of Yasir's bat.
Tossed up outside off and Yasir defends it with a straight bat.
Played to mid-wicket region by the Shah.
Loopy delivery outside off, Yasir tries to block it but misses the ball. The ball kept low there and missed the edge and the stumps.
Tossed up once again by  Somerville, Yasir pushes it back towards the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, Sarfraz tries to defend off his front foot. The ball finds the outside edge and goes towards the third man region for a single.
There is much more assurance in this defense as Yasir comes ahead and dead bats this looped one on middle.
Beaten outside off! Yasir prods ahead to defend but the turn after landing is just enough to beat his edge.
Good ball just on off stump, Yasir comes ahead and defends the ball. The ball takes the inside half and rolls onto the leg side.
Shorter and outside off this time, Sarfraz gets to the other end with a punch through the covers.
Full and outside off, Ahmed has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Sarfraz comes ahead to defend this one that is drifting down on the pads. He misses the ball and it hits him on his pads but impact is well outside leg.
Pitched up on the off Yasir hits it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Tossed up on middle, Yasir easily blocks it away.
Tossed up outside off, Yasir leaves it alone. The ball kept low and reached the keeper.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up again, Yasir defends off his front foot.
Tossed up on off, Sarfraz pushes it towards long on for a single.
Flatter ball outside off, Shah covers his stumps and leaves the ball.
Blocked out very comfortably from inside the crease.
Shorter ball outside off, Yasir stays back and pushes it to point.
Quicker one on middle, Shah has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter on the pads, the ball is jammed away to short mid-wicket.
Flighted on off, the batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! Taking the charge! Sarfraz charges down the pitch and lifts it over mid on for a boundary. Initially it looked like the ball crossed the rope but replays show that it bounced just inside the line.
Tossed up on the off stump, Yasir tries to defend off his front foot, the ball finds the outside edge and goes towards the third man region for a single.
Tossed up by Somerville, Yasir hits it straight back at the bowler.
Drifts away on the leg side, Yasir leaves it alone.
Tossed up on middle and leg, pushed away by Sarfraz towards mid on for a single.
Tossed up on middle, defended off his front foot.
Flatter ball on middle, Yasir comes ahead to defend but gets a thick inside edge that rolls to square leg. Lucky he got some bat on that, else he would have been plumb in front.
Yasir Shah is the new man in.

OUT! This one is not gonna change! Ajaz gets his second of the innings. Bilal has to depart. The ball is looped up generously outside off and Bilal can't hold back his drive. He gets a thick edge and Ross Taylor at slip takes a really smart catch. 333/7 now! The lead is 59.
This ball is flatter and on the pads, it is worked towards fine leg.
Tossed up on middle leg, Sarfraz pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Sarfraz tries to defend it off his front foot but the ball hits the inner half of the bat and goes to first slip on a bounce.
Drifts it away down the leg side, the ball hits Sarfraz's pads outside leg.
Floats it outside off, Asif blocks it.
Tosses it up on off, Asif defends it.

NOT OUT! It is turning down leg! Excellent use of the review. This is tossed up around off, it spins back in sharply. Bilal tries to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal follows, the umpire raises his finger. Asif has a chat with his skipper and then reviews. Hawk Eye shows the on-field call has to be overturned as the ball is spinning down and missing leg. Bilal survives to fight another day.
Review taken. Bilal Asif is caught leg before and given out. He's quick to take the DRS. Looks out to the naked eye, but it just could be turning down leg. Let's see now...
It is worked towards mid-wicket.
Ahmed now eases it down to long on for a run.
Tossed up outside off, Bilal tries to defend off his front foot but the ball finds the inside edge and goes towards short fine leg. A quick single is taken.
FOUR! There's no stopping this one though! Flighted on middle, Sarfraz pushes it beautifully straight down the ground and to the fence. Looked really elegant.
Short of a length delivery outside off, it has been cut away behind point on the off side. Good fielding, saves a run for his team.
Sharp turn after landing on middle, the ball turns just enough to beat the outside edge of Asif who was trying to defend. Beautiful ball, lucky for Bilal.
Outside off, Bilal does well to play it with soft hands as it takes an outside edge and drops short of slip.
Flatter and on middle, Bilal stays tall and plays it towards short mid-wicket.
Looped up outside off, Sarfraz pushes it towards cover and runs through for a quick single.
Short of a length this time, Asif pushes it away off his back foot towards the third man region for a brace.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up on off, defended off his front foot.
Pitched outside leg, Bilal shoulders arms to it but the ball hits his front pad.
Tossed up on the middle stump, Asif blocks it away.
Round the wicket, tossed up on his leg, blocked on the front foot.
Flatter and around off, Ahmed guides it towards point. He wants a run but is sent back.

Has that been dropped? Replays show there was no edge. This is bowled slower through the air around off, Sarfraz goes back, waits for the ball to come to him and then tries to guide it down towards the third man region. He though is beaten by the extra bounce and the keeper too fails to collect it.
On the shorter side, Asif goes back and then guides it towards third man for a single.
Another tossed up ball on off, the batsman is solid in defense.
This is floated on off, Asif lunges and blocks it out.
Flatter and shorter around off, the batsman goes back and then guides it to point for a single.
Tossed up again outside off, The Pakistan skipper pushes it towards cover for a single. He will keep the strike.
Tossed up on middle, Sarfraz has no trouble defending on his front foot.
Short of a length, the ball is defended by Sarfraz on the back foot.
Drifts away on the leg side, Sarfraz leaves it alone.
Tossed up on middle, Sarfraz pushes it towards mid on.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter delivery outside off, the batsman is comfortable in defense.
Full and outside off, Asif comes ahead and covers the line of the ball as he defends it.
Looped up outside off, Asif pushes it to cover.
FOUR! Such a tease for Tom Latham. The ball wins the race though. Width given by Patel, Bilal cuts it late and behind point. The ball runs away from the fielder and to the fence.
Looped up outside off, Bilal prods ahead and defends.
Flighted on off, Sarfraz pushes it to mid off and sets off for a quick single. The mid off fielder gets a direct hit at the striker's end but Bilal is safely inside.
Ajaz Patel to bowl from the other end.
A yorker to end, it is jammed out.
Another flighted ball on off, it is blocked.
Tosses it up on off, it is kept out.
Bilal Asif is the next batsman in.

OUT! Somerville strikes! One brings two, that is exactly the case in the debutant's case. A lucky wicket you can say. This is bowled very full on off, Azam tries to jam it out with a close face of the bat. He manages to hit it onto his boot and then the ball rolls onto the stumps. The Kiwis are ecstatic as they have struck three balls post the Tea break. Azam walks back dejected and New Zealand are fighting back here.
This is bowled very full on off, Azam tries to jam it out with a
Loopy delivery on the off stump. Defended well by Babar.
We are back for the final session of the day. Babar Azam and Sarfraz Ahmed will continue their innings. Will Somerville to start the proceedings after the break. Here we go...
... Day 3, Session 3 ...

A much better session for the Kiwis. 88 runs were scored in 28 overs, and Pakistan do have a lead of 38 at this moment in time, but they will be pleased to see the backs of Azhar Ali and Asad Shafiq, who scored their respective centuries and made a 201-run partnership. Somervile picked up his maiden Test wicket by removing the former and the latter was dismissed by Patel, who got his first of the game too. This is the perfect moment for New Zealand to make further inroads, but they still could face some stiff resistance from Azam and Sarfraz who are out there in the middle. The first hour of the final session will be crucial for both sides. It'll begin shortly...
On the stumps, it is blocked and Sarfraz starts walking back towards the dressing room as it is TEA ON DAY 3!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Well bowled! Gives it a lot more air outside off, Ahmed looks to drive away from his body but gets beaten by the away turn and bounce.
Floats it up on middle, it is driven back to the bowler.
Tossed up again this time on middle,  Sarfaraz defends it off his front foot.
Tossed up on middle and leg, pushed towards the on side for a single.
Slower through the air around off, Sarfraz lunges and blocks it out.
Uses his feet and then clips it to mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
This is floated up on middle, Azam flicks it through mid-wicket and a run is taken.
Another loopy ball on off, Babar comes forward and keeps it out.
Tosses it up around off, the batsman lunges and keeps it out.
Maiden over as Ahmed stays back in the crease and defends this ball.
Sarfraz comes down the track and plays this towards mid on.
Another drive to short cover.
Flighted outside off, the batsman drives it to short cover.
Full and on middle, the skipper comes ahead and dead bats it.
Shorter and outside off, Sarfraz cuts it away but straight to the fielder.
On the shorter side, Ahmed goes back and then guides it through point for a run.
On the pads again, Ahmed flicks it to square leg.
Works it through mid-wicket for a run.

FOUR! Punched away off the back foot by Babar through covers. Somerville bowls it short of a length, a loose delivery by Somerville and punished rightly by Babar Azam. Somerville should be doing much better here and not give away such loose deliveries to the new batsman.
Tossed up on off by Somerville, Azam defends it with a straight bat.
Shorter on length, the ball drifts away on the leg side. Babar flicks it away.
Tossed up on off, it is blocked.
Flatter and on off, Ahmed defends it.
Sarfraz Ahmed is the next batsman in.

OUT! AS PLUMB AS IT GETS! Shafiq falls shortly after getting to his ton. Takes a review with him. Ajaz Patel gets his first and now both the centurions are back in the hut. This is tossed up on middle, the ball pitches and straightens a touch. Asad plays outside the line, misses and the ball hits his front pad. The appeal follows and the umpire raises his finger. Shafiq walks upto his partner and then signals the 'T'. Hawk Eye returns with three reds. He walks off to a standing ovation. New Zealand now though would look to capitalize.
Shafiq is a goner! He has been judged out LBW but goes for the review. Only an inside edge can save him there.
FOUR! Up and over! Dances down the track and lofts it over mid off. The ball races away.
On middle, blocked.
On the stumps, it is kept out.
Ajaz Patel is back into the attack.

He does get it off the last ball! 12th Test ton for Asad Shafiq. He was eager to get this run and scrambles to the other end to get to it after stroking it to mid on. Takes his helmet off and soaks in the applause by his teammates. Just like all the top scorers from this game, this too has been a gritty innings. He though would want to continue. Also the 300 is up for Pakistan.
Another dot as it is flicked to the man at mid-wicket. One ball to go in this over and one run is what Asad needs.
A muted appeal! Another full ball, it drifts into the batter, Shafiq tries to flick but misses to get hit on the boot. Going down leg.
Uses his feet and swings but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket. Nerves getting to Shafiq here, he has started to get a little fidgety now.
This is worked with the turn to short leg.
Tosses it up on middle, it is kept out.
Length delivery outside off, Azam shoulders arms to it.

FOUR! Lucky! Short and outside off by Boult. Asad tries to defend off his back foot but the ball finds the inside half of the bat and luckily misses the stumps and goes towards the fine leg region for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, Azam blocks it off his back foot.
Bouncer! Short this time and Azam ducks underneath it.
Length delivery on the off stump, Asad pushes it towards midwicket for a single. Moves to 99 with that single.
Length delivery outside off, Shafiq lets it go.
Risky shot but nicely played in the end! It was on the stumps, Azam goes back and then opens the face of the bat. He guides it through point for a couple.
On the stumps, it is kept out.
Uses his feet and then hits it hard onto the ground. William gets a hand to it and deflects it to mid off.
This is worked towards short fine leg for a run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Tossed up on off, it is defended.
Comes back over the wicket and bowls on length outside off, Azam leaves it alone.
Short of a length outside off this time, Shafiq pushes it towards the third man region for a single. He moves onto 97 with that single.
Comes round the wicket and bowls it on length outside off, Asad has no troubles keeping it out.
Shorter in length this time, Shafiq blocks it away.
Full on the off stump, Asad defends off his front foot.
Full length outside off, Asad shoulders arms to it.
This is fired on off, Azam taps it towards point for a single.
This is shorter around off, Azam punches it through covers for a run.
Another floated delivery on off, it is blocked.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Another loopy ball on middle, the batter works it to short leg.
Slower through the air on off, the batsman stroked it to mid off.
Once again full outside off, Asad is being tempted to drive but he calmly leaves it alone.
Full length delivery outside off and Asad lets it go.
Fuller this time by Boult, Asad confidently defends it off his front foot.
Length delivery on middle and off, Asad blocks it away.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Shafiq flicks it towards  deep backward square leg for a couple.
Full outside off. Asad drives it towards mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Babar Azam to bat next.

OUT! First wicket of the day and the first of William Somerville's Test career. It's come at a crucial time too, as he breaks this marathon partnership of 201. He'll remember this one for a long time. New Zealand celebrate as they finally get their breakthrough. Tossed up on leg, Azhar Ali gets low to sweep but gets a top edge which goes straight to Ajaz Patel at backward square leg. Ali departs, but not before playing a superb knock. He's set his team up nicely and put Pakistan in a commanding position.
Good running. Shafiq taps this to covers and both batsmen take off quickly. A single is collected.
Brings out the broom but sweeps it straight to the man at square leg.
Spinning well down leg, Shafiq looks to go after it but misses.

Nicely done. Seeing the ball land on middle and spinning down, Shafiq gets forward and across before paddling it fine down the leg side. A couple of runs are taken and the 200-run stand between these two is up.
Full and outside off, once again it is shaping back in. Ali tries to drive it through covers but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Good shot and well fielded! Full and on middle, the batsman strokes it back right off the middle towards the bowler. Boult gets down quickly and makes a half-stop.
A huge appeal from behind the stumps but nothing from Boult as he knows it is going down leg. An in-dipper from around leg. The batsman tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.

FOUR! Slightly shorter this time and Azhar punches it off his back foot towards the third man fence. The ball races away to the boundary and with that, Azhar has scored more than 300 runs this series. He is really having a good series.
Full outside off and Azhar defends once again.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Azhar defends it.
Trent Boult is back on.
Tosses it up on off, Shafiq defends it.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
On the pads, the batsman works it around the corner for a run.
FOUR! Hammered! The ball is tossed above the eye line. Shafiq's eyes lit up on seeing the flight, uses his feet and smashes it through mid on for a boundary. Pakistan are into the lead now.
Flatter and on off, the batsman defends it.
Flicks it with the turn through mid-wicket for a single.
Drinks! These two have continued in their merry way. The trail is just 2 runs now and Pakistan are surely in the driver's seat now. Will they start getting more aggressive now?
Length delivery outside off and Asad lets it go.
Short of a length by Southee and Shafiq ducks underneath it. Southee is trying to trouble Shafiq with the bouncers but Asad is not having any problems dealing with those.
Length delivery outside off, the ball moves away from the batsman and Shafiq leaves it alone.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Azhar flicks it away towards square leg and rotates the strike.
Short of a length and pulled it away towards fine leg for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Shafiq lets it go.
Leans ahead to this full ball and knocks it towards mid on.
Straighter one on off, some pace on this one, Azhar stays right behind the line and defends it well.
Short and wide outside off, Asad backs away and punches it square of the wicket on the off side. One run taken.
Going down leg again, another leave by the batsman.
Spinning into the batsman, from around off, Shafiq looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Spinning down from leg stump, left alone.
William Somerville returns to the attack.
Fullish in length on off stump, Azhar is half forward and blocks it rather safely.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Touch fuller in length, just outside off, met with the full face of the bat.
Outside off on a good length, no shot offered.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, it goes off the pads and the batsmen take a leg bye.

Edged and FOUR! Fuller delivery outside off, Shafiq tries to defend off his front foot but finds an outside edge. The ball bounces just short of the gully fielder, he gets fingers to it but he's unable to stop it and the ball races away for a boundary. Pakistan now trail by just 6 runs.
Over the wicket for this one, Azhar comes ahead and lets the ball go outside his off stump.
This is sliding down the leg side and is played fine but straight to short fine leg fielder.
Well outside off, the ball is left alone by the batsman.
Short and wide outside off, Azhar plays it very late and it goes to the left of point for another couple.
Flatter and at the pads, the ball is worked away behind square leg for a single.
Short and outside off, cut away to point. No run.
Length delivery on the off stump this time and Azhar drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Length delivery outside off and Ali is patient and not going after those.
Southee is bowling on length this over but Azhar is not tempted to disturb those.
Length delivery outside off and Azhar shoulders arms to it.
Length delivery outside off, a bit of movement off the pitch away from the batsman and Azhar lets it go.
Fuller outside off, Asad tries to drive it but misses the ball.
Tosses it on middle, it is kept out. So the balls which are pitched outside the off pole are misbehaving, not a worry for the batters.

Bounce and turn! This is tossed up outside off, the ball pitches and turns away. Also takes off after pitching. Asad is beaten as he tries to defend. The keeper whips the bails off and appeals. The bowler is appealing for a caught behind but neither of the two umpires are interested.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
This is eased down to long on for a single.
Flatter around off, Ali waits for the ball to come to him and then guides it through cover-point for a single.
Gives it air on off, Ali finds the cover fielder with a drive.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

EDGED BUT FOUR! Full marks to the bowler here but runs to the batsman! Frustrating this for New Zealand. Luck is just not favoring them at the moment. On a length and around off, Asad tries to defend but does so with hard hands. The ball takes the outside edge and flashes past the diving gully fielder and into the third man fence.
This seems to be a ploy! Another short one outside off, Asad lets it go through to the keeper.
Pulled nicely but finds the fielder! Short and on middle, the batsman pulls it hard to the fielder at square leg.
Back of a length around off, Asad stands tall and keeps it out.
Good length again around off, Shafiq guides it to point.
On the shorter side this, Ali goes back and pushes it to covers. 6 from this one and 10 from Patel's last.
On middle this time, it is easily negotiated.
On off, kept out.
Strokes it down to long off for a run.

FOUR! Shafiq is looking to go after Patel. He scored two boundaries in his last over and now scores one on the first ball he faces in this over. Excellent use of the feet and wrists here. Gets to the pitch of it and then whips it through mid-wicket. 250 up.
On the shorter side, the batter punches it through covers for a single.
Third bouncer from Southee in the over, good energy from him. Shafiq ducks under.
Another length ball around off, Ali this time times it through covers and gets to the other end.
Nope, he goes back to bowling length. Asad pushes it towards covers for a run.
Another short ball and it is ducked under with ease. Two bouncers, now time for a yorker?

Good carry there! Not seen a lot of deliveries bounce like the last one. Southee may have really given it all on that delivery. It is short and on the body. Asad ducks under it and the keeper collects it at head height.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batter, Ali flicks it through square leg for a run.
Flatter and on the pads, Ali works it around the corner and gets to the other end. 10 from the over and the trail is below 30.
Loopy delivery on off, Ali pushes it to covers.
Very full on the pads, this is eased down to long on and a run is taken.
Loopy ball on off, Shafiq lunges and keeps it out.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries! Asad may have decided to step on the gas. He uses his feet, gets to the pitch of it and hits it hard past the diving mid off fielder.
FOUR! The sweep shot is brought out once again and it has been hit really well through square leg. No stopping those.
The physio is out to have a check on him. Ali though now seems fine to continue.

OHHHH! The inside edge saves Ali there. This pitches around off and then jags back in. Ali at the very end gets some part of the bat to the ball and it deflects onto his unmentionable area. He is down on his haunches.
Another bouncer! This one though hurries onto the batsman. Shafiq mistimes his pull towards fine leg for a run. 150-run stand is up between the two. This is taking the game away from New Zealand.
A bumper but too easy for the batsman to duck under on this wicket. There is just no pace at all.
A little too straight this time, it is flicked through square leg and a run is taken. They now only trail by 10 less than 50.
Back of a length around off, Ali easily blocks it out.
A good delivery to begin his second over after the break. Good length and around off, Ali's feet are rooted to the crease, he tries to defend but the ball goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
On the shorter side outside off, Ali punches it through covers for a single.
Well bowled! Ali though did not need to go after that. It is a loopy ball around off, it pitches and then turns away. Ali is drawn into a defensive stroke but the away turn beats his outside edge.
FOUR! Swept and swept well! Ali goes down on one knee and then nails the sweep shot through square leg for a boundary. He has really played this shot well.
Slower through the air this time, Ali blocks it out.
Another one which skids after pitching around off, Ali pushes it to covers.
Flatter and a touch shorter, skids off the surface. Ali goes back and tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. A stifled appeal but the ball seems to be going down leg.
Nice looking cover drive but only for a run. Full and around off, Ali leans into the stroke and times it towards extra cover for a single. Keeps strike.
Good length around off, Ali gets right behind the line of the delivery and blocks it out.
Gets it right this time. On middle and straightening a touch. Asad tries to defend but it goes off the inner half through square leg for a single.
Down the leg side this time, Southee has not got it right to begin with. Asad does not bother playing at it.
Another ball outside off, Asad shoulders arms to it.
Good length outside off, Shafiq lets it be. The ball does not even carry to the keeper who collects the ball with a dive.
Tim Southee to bowl from the other end.

A good delivery to end the over! It is tossed up around off, this one straightens a touch. Shafiq plays inside the line with soft hands. The ball takes the outside edge and goes towards third man for a single.
Similar length but the line is a little too straight this time. It is worked to mid-wicket.
Better! This is flatter and lands it around off, it is not very full and hence, the ball is given a chance to turn. The ball does not though, Asad lunges and blocks it out.
Another very full delivery around off, the spin is out of contention as it is very full, Ali drives it through covers for a single.
Gives it a little more air around off, Ali strokes it to mid off.
Starts off with a delivery outside off, Ali lets it be.

Welcome back to the second session. The players are strolling back to the field of play. The stand is worth 139 already, how much more can these two add? Azhar Ali to face the first ball after resumption. Ajaz Patel to bowl.
... Day 3, Session 2 ...

Pakistan's session without a doubt. In 29 overs, 85 runs were scored without the loss of a wicket. The two batsmen who were there overnight are still out there in the middle and they haven't looked in trouble at any point during the session. The runs have come at a faster rate than yesterday and the deficit has been trimmed down to a mere 50. The highlights of the session were Azhar Ali's 15th Test hundred and Asad Shafiq also getting to his 22nd Test fifty. Even the new ball has not done any magic for the visitors. Pakistan look set for a massive first innings total. Can New Zealand do something different in the post-Lunch session and strike back? Join us in a while for that session.
A dot to end a very good over. On a length and on off, the batsman keeps it out. That will be LUNCH ON DAY 3!

BEAUTY! Two short balls and then follows it up with a peach. Length around middle, it pitches and then seams away. Also gets good bounce off the surface. Shafiq has a poke at it and luckily for him, he gets beaten.
Another bumper, this time from over the wicket. It is down the leg side, ducked under.
Bends his back on this one and also shortens the length. The ball though bounces at a comfortable height for the batsman. Shafiq stands tall and defends it onto the ground.
Slightly fuller around off, Shafiq lunges and strokes it crisply towards mid off. The fielder there makes a good stop diving to his right.
Angles this one down the leg side, Shafiq tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. A muted appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head.
Wide outside off, left alone by Azhar. Smart batting, no need to play at that.
FOUR! Flicked away beautifully and beats a diving mid on to his right. The lead of New Zealand has come down to 50. Pakistan in a very strong position here. Ali has moved to 111.
Slightly overpitched, Azhar Ali goes for the drive. He finds Williamson at cover who dives to stop it but can't stop it completely. The batsmen run through for a couple till the ball comes back.
Another ball on a length and it is dead batted by Azhar who is on the front foot.
Fuller in length, Ali drives it to mid off.
Full and outside off, Azhar comes ahead and defends it towards cover.
Back to around the wicket, Shafiq gets hit on the thigh pad as he tries to defend it coming half ahead.
Over the wicket now, Ali stands tall and flicks it away to deep square leg for a run.
Short of a length and on middle, pushed away to short mid-wicket.
Short ball outside off. Defended straight back to the bowler off the back foot.
Short ball outside off, Azhar jumps and tries to punch it through covers. The ball moves in after landing and gets the inside half of the bat. It goes to short mid-wicket.
Around the wicket, effort ball from Boult. But it is well outside off and left alone.
Full ball outside off, Shafiq drives it straight to short cover.
Closer to the off stump now, Shafiq has played that on the front foot and into the ground.
A swinging ball outside off, defended away from the body by Asad.
Another good ball to follow it up, outside off and slightly moving away. Azhar pokes at it and gets to the other end as the ball rolls to cover.
Good ball! On a good length and in the corridor of uncertainty. Azhar decides to pull out of his shot at the last moment. Could have been dangerous.
Well outside off, left alone by the batsman.
Colin de Grandhomme back into the attack.
Bowls it a bit fuller on this occasion, played back down the track in the bowler's direction. Maiden over from Boult.
Brings out the short one and hits the deck hard. It's accurate and angling in, the batsman ducks and evades.
Shaping back in from around off, Shafiq presents a tight defensive shot in response.
In the channel outside off, on a good length, left alone by the batsman.
Cutting into the batsman off the seam, Shafiq stays inside his crease and blocks it out.
Swinging back in from outside off, pushed off the front foot to the cover area.
Azhar flicks it off his hips but straight to square leg. No run. Maiden over.
This one is delivered from a little wider from the crease, but the ball is well outside off again. Left alone by the batsman.
Well outside off, Ali decides he wants nothing to do with it.
Just outside off on a length, Ali defends it toward point.
That's much better! On a length and top of off stump, Azhar defends it with a straight bat.
Outside off and the ball keeps pretty low as it goes through to the keeper who is down on his knees as he collects this one. Southee needs to make the batsman play.
Over the wicket again, the ball holds it's line and Shafiq shoulders his arms to it.
Well outside off this time, left alone easily.
Another one coming in with the angle and swinging more, Shafiq doesn't look too comfortable as he somehow manages to play it to square leg.
Around the wicket, the ball jags into Shafiq and he was in no position to play that one. It hits him on the pad, goes onto his elbow and rolls so close to his off pole. Very lucky for the batsman.
Just outside off, the batsman gauges the swing on it and lets it go through.
Well outside off, Asad goes for the expansive drive through the covers, but the ball takes the inside part of the bat and rolls to mid-wicket.
Slightly straighter this time, this is worked through mid-wicket and the batsmen take a run. A tight over but not a threatening one.
Third leave in a row! Wasting the new ball for now is New Zealand. Outside off, it is shouldered arms.
Another one outside off, the batsman has no interest in playing at those. Need to make the batsman play, for now they are bowling too wide.

Outside off and some shape on it, but the batsman leaves it alone easily.

Drinks break. Pakistan's hour all the way and comprehensively so! New Zealand's bowlers have looked toothless and desperately need a breakthrough. They will be waiting for the new ball which will be available in 5 overs. Will things continue how they are now or will we see a Black Caps resurgence?

Bouncer to Shafiq! Effort ball that. Asad calmly ducks under it.
Short ball outside off, Ali drops it onto the off side and runs through for a quick single. It is the 150 up for the hosts.
Full ball outside off, Azhar takes a step forward and drives it to mid off.

Fuller and on middle, pushed to mid on with a straight bat.
Looped up outside off on this occasion. The batsman comes ahead and defends it.
Shafiq cuts this one to point. No run.
Quicker again outside off, Ali cuts it away behind point for another three.
Around the wicket, flatter ball and pushed quicker on middle. Azhar defends it to point.
Ajaz Patel to bowl from the other end.
Fuller and outside off, he shoulders arms to this one. 7 runs off the first over of the day.
Good ball first up to Shafiq, it is on a length and on middle. The batsman is half forward and defends it comfortably.
On the pads and it is flicked away by Ali for three in front of square on the leg side. Good running, that.
Short of a length and on top of off stump, Azhar stands tall and defends it straight back.
Outside off but fuller this time, it's left alone.

FOUR! The first ball of the day goes to the boundary. It was short and wide outside off, and Azhar Ali just puts his bat at it and guides it in the gap between gully and point. Good start for Pakistan.

We are ready to begin. The Black Caps are in a huddle by the boundary line and now, make their way on to the field. Azhar Ali and Asad Shafiq will continue from where they left off. Trent Boult will take the ball first up this morning. A lone slip and a gully in place for him. Here we go...

Welcome to Day 3 of this final Test between Pakistan and New Zealand. Some breaking news for those who have missed out - Mohammad Hafeez has decided to draw the curtains on his 15-year long Test career after this final game. Pretty sure it's going to be an emotional affair for the Pakistan camp. Talking about the game, it is evenly poised as things stand. Both sides will fancy their chances, and would like to start off this day with a bang. A few wickets for the visitors would set the alarm bells ringing in the Pakistan camp, whereas one solid stand for the hosts could see some shoulders drop on the Black Caps' side. Ideally, the hosts would want this pair to continue for as long as possible. The pitch seems to be lifeless and dry, and is not that tough for batting. Pakistan just seem to be slightly ahead with the deficit only 135 runs now, but all that can change in a matter of minutes if they lose wickets in clumps. What will happen? Join us for the first session of play which will begin in a little time from now.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

What will the two teams be looking for on Day 3? Both the sides will be eager for a lead. New Zealand need wickets quickly and Pakistan need one big partnership. Who will have the advantage at the end of the 'moving day'? Join us to find out as the action resumes on Wednesday at 1000 local (0600 GMT) ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Earlier in the day, BJ Watling's excellent knock helped New Zealand get to a competitive total. Bilal Asif was the key man for the hosts picking up five wickets. In reply, Pakistan lost both their openers cheaply, courtesy, Trent Boult. Haris Sohail and Azhar Ali, then, added 68 and took Pakistan to safer shores. The latter continued after the wicket of the former and got to his fifty. Also, Azhar's partnership with Asad is turning out to be a threatening one.

It has been a good day of Test cricket. The hosts will be happy going into the dressing room after the day's play. The home team did lose the wicket of Haris Sohail early on after Tea. But Asad Shafiq and Azhar Ali steadied the ship and have given the home side the edge.

New Zealand's session it has been. They added vital 45 runs first and have also dismissed Hafeez for a duck. The visitors are right on top at the moment. They also have momentum on their side and would like to continue the same after the break. Pakistan on the other hand, are under pressure at the moment. They need a couple of partnerships after the break. Will the hosts fight back after Lunch or will the visitors chip away with the wickets?
